about_the_game:
"Nothing in the world is perfect, just as there is no such thing as absolute despair."

Dedicated to all those perfectionist steaks who, after countless falls and crushing defeats, still rise again and again, relentlessly striving for the perfect medium rare.

Medium Rare is a darkly humorous physics-based platformer.

You wake up one day as a steak. Propelled solely by your own muscle power, you must rediscover and navigate this bizarre world. Of course, as a steak, you are forever drawn to the flame—you yearn to be cooked, to become the perfect and enticing delicacy in the eyes of others.

Start from Scratch

You'll begin from scratch, learning to adapt to your new body. Sometimes it’s too tender, sometimes too slippery. At first, you’ll face painful failures—some so severe you can barely move. But from these failures, you’ll learn and grow, becoming the finest among steaks.

Overcome Challenges

As your skills improve, you’ll conquer one challenge after another. Gradually, you’ll master balance, find the right rhythm, and learn to maneuver with agility. Leap into frying pans and plates, completing a variety of uniquely styled challenges.

The Ultimate Test

At the end of your journey, you’ll face the ultimate trial—a testament to your status as a one-of-a-kind, perfect steak. Upon reaching the summit, you’ll receive an incredible reward and earn a place on the global steak leaderboard, making your name known worldwide.

Multiplayer Mode

You can also team up with friends, playing as steaks or other ingredients, to tackle more complex culinary creations or engage in thrilling steak races.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760 or AMD Radeon R7 260x (2GB VRAM)
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700K or AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 3060 or AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT (12GB VRAM)
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: As a steak, you must rediscover and navigate this bizarre world, overcome daunting challenges, and cook yourself to perfection to become a delectable delicacy. You can also team up with your friends and dash into thrilling, high-speed steak races!
supported_languages:
English, Simplified Chinese*, Traditional Chinese*
*languages with full audio support
